Brief.Title: Candy Factory Tycoon
Brief.Pitch: Build the sweetest factory on the server: droppers, conveyors and a giant candy machine.
Brief.TargetPlayers: 8-13 year olds who like building and numbers going up
Brief.CoreLoop: Buy droppers that make candy, collect the cash, buy upgrades, then rebirth for a permanent multiplier.
MustHave: A plot per player with droppers, a conveyor and a collector
At least 12 buttons in a sensible order
DoneWhen: A new player can buy their first dropper in under a minute

Findings: Three food-themed tycoons entered the top 50 this month.
